content: {"reasoning":"The corrected COB order moved the claim from CO-22 to PR-204, confirming the primary payer considers the service noncovered under the lapsed plan. An appeal based on medical necessity would not cure a plan-coverage denial or the invalid diagnosis pairing, and retro authorization and peer review are unavailable; because valid secondary coverage exists, the balance should be sent there rather than billed to the patient or written off.","action":"bill_secondary"}
